modules.name: API Gateway
modules.description: Multi-version HTTP API gateway with filesystem routing; serves v1/v2 RPC endpoints, agent-readiness metadata (RFC 9728/8414), A2A protocol endpoint, NLWeb /ask endpoint; catch-all returns structured JSON 404

modules.name: API Middleware
modules.description: Underscore-prefixed route-less modules: API key + session-token authentication, timing-safe comparison, Host-derived metadata origin resolver, token-overlap tool routing for A2A/NLWeb

modules.name: Frontend SPA
modules.description: TypeScript single-page application — real-time global intelligence dashboard with AI-powered news aggregation, geopolitical monitoring, infrastructure tracking

modules.name: Backend Server
modules.description: Backend server code; multi-domain data pipeline aggregating from dozens of external sources; handles freshness, reliability, edge compute

modules.name: Lint & Enforcement Scripts
modules.description: CI-verified boundary enforcement: API contract lint (sebuf format), rate-limit policies, premium-fetch rules, safe-HTML, Mintlify slug reservation, module boundary lint

modules.name: Documentation Portal
modules.description: Mintlify-powered developer documentation; auto-generated capability stats from code; architecture decision records (architecture.mdx)

modules.name: Test Suite
modules.description: Unit tests (tests/) and end-to-end pipeline tests (e2e/); API-key validation tests use node:test with env-var injection

control_flow: HTTP request arrives at API Gateway → filesystem router dispatches to concrete v1/v2 RPC handler or falls through to catch-all JSON 404
Agent-to-Agent (A2A) or NLWeb /ask request → _agent-tool-suggest.ts computes token-overlap score across published tool names + descriptions → routes to best-matching tool handler
API key validation flow: request → getHeaderApiKey() → validateApiKey() with timing-safe comparison → optional session-token upgrade via isSessionTokenShape() + validateSessionToken()

Agent-readiness metadata discovery: request → OAuth protected-resource metadata (RFC 9728) or authorization-server metadata (RFC 8414) → resolveMetadataOrigin() validates Host header → returns endpoint origin-consistent documents
CI/CD pipeline: commit → lint-staged (Prettier) → npm run lint (Biome + boundary/enforcement scripts) → npm run docs:check (stats auto-verification) → build + deploy
data_flow: External source data → Backend Server multi-domain pipeline → aggregation + freshness tracking → API Gateway → Frontend SPA real-time dashboard rendering

Lint-time data flow: code changes → scripts/enforce-sebuf-api-contract.mjs validates API spec conformance → scripts/enforce-rate-limit-policies.mjs checks rate-limit annotations → scripts/enforce-premium-fetch.mjs validates premium data access patterns
Documentation data flow: source code → scripts/docs-stats.mjs extracts capability counts → docs/generated/stats.json → Mintlify renders capability table; num change triggers docs:check failure
Desktop runtime data flow: Tauri origin (tauri://localhost, asset://localhost) → _api-key.js DESKTOP_ORIGIN_PATTERNS validation → authorized API access without standard browser CORS

plugin_points: api/v1/[rpc].ts — per-RPC handler extension for v1 API (open registration via filesystem)
api/v2/[rpc].ts — per-RPC handler extension for v2 API
api/a2a.ts — A2A (Agent-to-Agent) protocol endpoint; tool list extensible via tool/ namespace
api/ask.ts — NLWeb natural-language endpoint; tool routing via _agent-tool-suggest.ts token-overlap
OAuth protected-resource metadata (RFC 9728) — agent-discovery-ready endpoint metadata
MCP (Model Context Protocol) tool descriptors — published anonymously via tools/list
public_api: GET/POST /api/v1/[rpc] — Version 1 RPC family (17 analyzers / 11 semantic analyzers at runtime)
GET/POST /api/v2/[rpc] — Version 2 RPC family (shipping, multi-domain pipeline)
GET /api/* (catch-all) — Structured JSON 404 for unmatched paths

major_changes.change: v1→v2 API versioning: /api/v1/ and /api/v2/ namespaces with separate routing
major_changes.impact: Allowed backward-compatible evolution; v2 added shipping, multi-domain pipeline endpoints without breaking v1 consumers

major_changes.change: Agent-readiness layer: added RFC 9728/8414 metadata endpoints + A2A protocol
major_changes.impact: Enabled agent-to-agent discovery and LLM integration; expanded from human-only UI to agent-consumable API

major_changes.change: Lint-time enforcement suite: boundary lint, API contract lint, rate-limit policies, premium-fetch, safe-HTML
major_changes.impact: Shifted from runtime-only validation to compile-time contract verification; prevents contract drift before deployment

major_changes.change: Desktop runtime (Tauri) support: added DESKTOP_ORIGIN_PATTERNS and session-token-based API key validation
major_changes.impact: Opened native desktop client path without separate auth backend; Tauri origins validated at API gateway

major_changes.change: Mintlify-powered documentation auto-generation from source code
major_changes.impact: Docs/code single-source-of-truth; npm run docs:check validates doc accuracy in CI; capability stats auto-derived from code
Reduced latency for geographically distributed users; edge compute handles pre-processing before centralized aggregation

evolution.current_direction: Consolidating agent-native capabilities (A2A + MCP + NLWeb) as the primary consumption model alongside the SPA dashboard; deepening compile-time contract enforcement; expanding multi-domain data pipeline reliability and observability across 30+ domains; documentation-as-code with CI-verified freshness
